svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Backed Buying Operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Backed Buying Operation; subtitle: Launch controls and buyer coverage before forcing a first purchase; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Milestones describe controllable setup work, not required sales outcomes. Canonical time to first deal is 1–6 months. If no lot passes the documented bid criteria, complete the sprint with a qualified watchlist and retained cash.; caption: Auction alerts, bid-limit worksheets, and inventory tracking support the operator; none replaces inspection, title verification, removal capacity, or buyer demand.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and operating constraints; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose two initial asset classes and a pickup radius. Review seller terms and applicable permits, create a restricted-property exclusion list, and obtain storage, insurance, and carrier quotations. Deliver a written buying mandate and capital budget.; label: Days 8-14; value: Build buyer evidence and unit economics; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Interview ten prospective business buyers and document specifications, delivery constraints, and payment practices. Configure GSA Auctions, GovPlanet, GovDeals, and Public Surplus alerts. Price five candidate lots using resale evidence and complete landed-cost bid worksheets.; label: Days 15-21; value: Validate condition and removal execution; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Arrange inspections for up to three qualified lots when access is available. Resolve title documents, obtain written freight estimates, assign pod responsibilities, and test inventory records. Bid only when the four pre-flight checks pass.; label: Days 22-30; value: Execute conditionally and review the cohort; numeric value: 30.0; detail: If awarded a qualifying lot, settle and remove it on the seller's timetable, record actual condition, and begin buyer outreach. Otherwise continue qualification. Review cash commitments, inspection losses, inventory aging, and expected versus actual landed costs.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Backed Buying Operation
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Backed Buying Operation

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define scope and operating constraints; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose two initial asset classes and a pickup radius. Review seller terms and applicable permits, create a restricted-property exclusion list, and obtain storage, insurance, and carrier quotations. Deliver a written buying mandate and capital budget.

label: Days 8-14; value: Build buyer evidence and unit economics; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Interview ten prospective business buyers and document specifications, delivery constraints, and payment practices. Configure GSA Auctions, GovPlanet, GovDeals, and Public Surplus alerts. Price five candidate lots using resale evidence and complete landed-cost bid worksheets.

text.title: Build buyer evidence and unit economics

circle.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Validate condition and removal execution; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Arrange inspections for up to three qualified lots when access is available. Resolve title documents, obtain written freight estimates, assign pod responsibilities, and test inventory records. Bid only when the four pre-flight checks pass.

label: Days 22-30; value: Execute conditionally and review the cohort; numeric value: 30.0; detail: If awarded a qualifying lot, settle and remove it on the seller's timetable, record actual condition, and begin buyer outreach. Otherwise continue qualification. Review cash commitments, inspection losses, inventory aging, and expected versus actual landed costs.

text.title: Execute conditionally and review the cohort

Assumptions: Milestones describe controllable setup work, not required sales outcomes. Canonical time to first deal is 1–6 months. If no lot passes the documented bid criteria, complete the sprint with a qualified watchlist and retained cash.
